talks.title: Lessons from visualizing uncertainty in production
talks.speaker: Wen Kowalski
talks.abstract: Why visualizing uncertainty is harder than it looks, and a design that holds up. We compare three approaches and explain the trade-offs we accepted. Expected audience: about 43 participants.

talks.title: Voice interfaces without the hype
talks.speaker: Wen Silva
talks.abstract: This talk walks through how our team approached voice interfaces over the past year. Expect concrete numbers, a few failure stories and an open-source companion repo. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 20 people.
